title: Deeper at constant width: 8 -> 10 layers, dim stays 512
description: DEPTH 8 -> 10 and ASPECT_RATIO 64 -> 48, so model_dim stays 512 with 4 heads of 128; nothing else changed.
reflection: Clear win: val_bpb 0.989595 vs baseline 0.997358 (-0.0078, ~8x the ~0.001 noise floor seen in round 0). Capacity, not optimization, was the binding constraint. The trade was 375.5M tokens vs ~412M (-9%) and 2865 steps for 60.8M params vs 50.3M; steady-state MFU actually ROSE to 37.3% from ~33%, because the extra depth amortises per-step optimizer/Python overhead over more useful work. Peak VRAM 27.8GB vs 22.2GB (the fp32 logits tensor still dominates). Round 0 (batch size, flat) and round 1 (head split, negative) were both probing knobs that do not bind; the model was simply too small for the compute. Next step on this axis is DEPTH 12 with ASPECT_RATIO 40 (dim stays 512) to find where the capacity/token trade turns over; VRAM would go to ~31GB, still fine.
